Container.Name: skwod
Container.Overview: Host your own skwod: private, end-to-end-encrypted group chat with voice and video for you and your friends. The admin page is published on 127.0.0.1 of the Unraid box only (it is plain HTTP and shows the owner setup code): from your computer run "ssh -L 3477:127.0.0.1:3477 root@your-unraid-box", open http://127.0.0.1:3477, type the one-time admin token from this container's log (Docker tab, click the icon, Logs), press "Start server" and send the invite to your friends. No domain, no port forwarding and no account are needed: friends reach your server by its key. The server stores only encrypted messages and cannot read them. Voice and video are built in (a LiveKit server runs inside the container and is never exposed).
Container.Requires: Outbound UDP must be allowed (it is by default).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything the server keeps: the encrypted database and attachments, and the keys that ARE your server's address. Back this folder up; if you lose it, every invite stops working.

Config.Name: Connection port (UDP)
Config.Description: How friends' apps reach the server. Nothing needs forwarding; forwarding this UDP port on your router is optional and makes direct connections more likely. If you change the host port, set the same number in 'P2P port' below.

Config.Name: Admin page address
Config.Description: Leave as is: the address INSIDE the container. On the Unraid box the page is published on 127.0.0.1 only (Extra Parameters); reach it through an SSH tunnel. It is protected by a one-time token printed in the container log.

Config.Name: Wait for Start button
Config.Description: Serve nobody until you press Start server on the admin page. Your choice is remembered.

Config.Name: P2P port
Config.Description: Must match the container side of 'Connection port (UDP)'.

Config.Name: Run as (uid:gid)
Config.Description: The unprivileged user the server runs as (Unraid's nobody:users).

Config.Name: Use public relays as a fallback
Config.Description: true: when a direct connection is impossible, traffic goes through iroh's public relays (still end-to-end encrypted; the relay sees IP addresses and timing). false: direct connections only, strictly independent, but some friends may not be able to connect.

Config.Name: Find on local network
Config.Description: Leave empty (off). Only useful with Network set to 'host'; can also be switched on the admin page.
